ui.law: Florida lets you assign a purchase contract. Never market the house itself, only your contract, and put the assignment right in the contract. Florida is a judicial foreclosure state, so lis pendens filings are public at the Comptroller.
ui.groups: "Central Florida Realty Investors (CFRI)", "Orlando Real Estate Investors", "Florida Wholesale Deals"
ui.prefc: No homestead: Florida owners file a homestead exemption on the house they live in. No exemption means a rental, a second home or an inherited house, so every lead here is absentee by the appraiser's own records. Housing code case: a county inspector found the house unsafe, burned, unsecured or in disrepair and the owner is facing fines and repairs.
ui.buyers_note: Companies that bought 2 or more houses in the last 18 months, from the county sale data, most active first. Skip the big institutions and builders; the 2 to 20 purchase LLCs are the ones who buy wholesale deals. Look up the owner on Sunbiz and call.
ui.buyers_empty: No buyers found in the sale data yet.
ui.repairs: Repairs, Orlando rough numbers per house: cosmetic 15-25k, kitchen+baths 30-50k, roof 15-25k (insurance needs it), AC 8-14k, full gut 60-100k.
ui.sources: Orange County Property Appraiser parcel layer (owner, mailing address, homestead flag, living area, year built, market value, last sale), Orange County Code Enforcement active violations (housing and lot cases)
